svg.text: How the residual stream is computed
Pre-norm decoder-only transformer (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, Mistral...) — one token position shown, going up through the layers

g.text: ... layers 1 … ℓ−1: same stream, earlier blocks

svg.text: Key idea: blocks never overwrite the stream, they only add to it. The stream is therefore one shared vector in
(a few thousand dimensions), and every block reads from and writes to that same space.
